name: ktm_620_lc4e
label: KTM 620 LC4 609 cc single

sources.what: KTM 'Technical Data - Engine KTM 620 LC4-E' sheet (PDF dated April 1998, includes 620 Duke carburettor settings), hosted by a KTM dealer shop. Manufacturer technical data: bore, stroke, compression, valve timing at 1 mm, valve diameters, carburettor.
A second KTM technical data sheet for the 620 LC4-E with the same cam timing and valve sizes but 10.5:1 compression.
Third-party motorcycle spec database: power and torque for the 1997 620 LC4 Adventure. Unverified.
Online copy of the KTM 690 Supermoto owner's manual, technical data - engine page; used only for the related-engine note.
Press test of the 2009 KTM 690 Duke; used only for the related-engine note.

notes: Sourced: bore, stroke, compression ratio, four valves and their diameters, valve events at 1 mm lift (14/55/56/13), 40 mm carburettor (runner_d, inferred by the researcher from the PHM 40 type name). Published output is from a third-party database for the 620 LC4 Adventure, not a KTM figure for the Duke. Estimated, not sourced: rod length, valve lifts, intake tract length, all exhaust dimensions (header length and diameter, pipe, silencer and tail pipe), flywheel inertia, redline, idle, friction_scale and heat_q (tuned). The single carburettor is modelled as an individual throttle. Not modelled: the balancer shaft.

vehicle.name: KTM 620 Duke (1997)
vehicle.notes: 1997 '4th edition', the last 609 cc Duke (the 1998 Last Edition is 625 cc). curb_kg is MOTORRAD's measured full-tank weight for a 1996-97 e-start Duke; KTM's own figure is 145 kg without fuel, about 153 kg with it. top_speed_kmh is MOTORRAD's measured figure for the same bike; its data box gives a 1.8 L reserve, which matches the 1996 3rd edition, whose only gearing difference is 2nd gear 24:16. final_drive is primary 81:30 x chain 38:17. wheel_radius_m is calculated from the tyre size.
